title: Zahari greets John Paul at their first meeting, a friendship made on the Hill

tellings.quote: when zahari walked into the house he's like hey John Paul blah they had this whole relationship and they said it had been built on the hill

plain: When a nonspeaking young person named Zahari walked into a house in Georgia in 2023 and met another named John Paul for the first time, he greeted him like an old friend, and the two said their friendship had been built on "the hill," a place the children describe meeting in their minds. The filmmaker Ky Dickens, who made The Telepathy Tapes, a documentary about nonspeaking children said to read minds, tells it to Michels as it was told to her. If true, it would suggest the children had been in touch by telepathy before ever meeting.
